caller_contract_deviations.classification: Applied source simplification; final-tree execution and gates pending.

append.native: appendTriple accepts consecutive change triples in its general helper contract.
append.rust: Private Context::append has only Context::all as caller. Its traversal separates changed leaves with positive COPY triples, so only a copy-only tail can merge.
append.omitted: Two merge alternatives for consecutive change triples are omitted because this caller cannot produce them. This does not claim arbitrary private-helper equivalence.

caller_contract_deviations.equal: IgnoreAll hashes encode identical non-space counts after the same signed-byte indentation. The zero-count case returns through the prefix comparison. Successful paired comparisons consume positive counts together and skip trailing spaces, so both cursors remain in bounds together at each loop entry. The redundant paired bounds guard and asymmetric-finish guard are omitted under that invariant. Genuine content collisions still use byte comparison.
caller_contract_deviations.line_admission: Successful splitting preserves the exact LF-plus-unterminated-line count admitted before allocation. The repeated post-split bound is omitted; both checked additions and all original admission limits remain.
caller_contract_deviations.preserved: Every charged work operation, error order, checked arithmetic operation, upstream attribution and native fixture is retained.
